items.title: Where Does Oil Go Next After the Hormuz Crisis?
items.summary: Samantha Dart, Co-Head of Global Commodities Research at Goldman Sachs, discusses how oil prices may develop if the conflict in the Strait of Hormuz continues to escalate, and warns that a supply glut may pose a challenge even if the supply interruptions are resolved.

items.title: Apple Soared 15% in July, but GPIQ Holders Lost 6%: The Hidden Options Tax on Covered-Call ETFs
items.summary: Apple just posted its strongest June quarter ever and surged double digits, yet one popular income ETF built around Nasdaq-100 giants moved in the opposite direction. Understanding why reveals a hidden cost that never appears on the fund's expense-ratio line.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Expects S&P 500 Volatility to Increase Ahead of U.S. Midterm Elections
items.summary: With the U. S. midterm elections now just three months away, Goldman Sachs believes political developments are likely to become a more influential driver of market sentiment, potentially leading to higher volatility in the S&P 500 over the coming months.

items.title: US Treasury intervenes to support yen through purchases - FT
items.summary: Investing.com -- The U.S. Treasury intervened in currency markets on Friday by purchasing yen, joining Japan’s efforts to support the currency from near four-decade lows, the Financial Times reported.
